economic_thesis: Token-specific relative returns have two causal path states. Persistent established paths reflect slow information and collateral diffusion and tend to continue, while an independent two-day displacement against a low-coherence path reflects temporary liquidity pressure and tends to reverse. A fixed per-symbol coherence blend should preserve two-sided relative alpha in bull, bear, and chop without reading a common-market direction or organizer regime.

expected_regime_roles.bear: Coherent relative laggards continue in the short sleeve while resilient tokens occupy the long sleeve.
expected_regime_roles.bull: Coherent relative leaders continue in the long sleeve while relative laggards remain the short sleeve.
expected_regime_roles.chop: Low path coherence shifts the fixed blend toward reversal of independent two-day displacement on both sides.
expected_regime_roles.long_sleeve: Long the highest final path-adaptive relative ranks; positive long-bull attribution is mandatory.
expected_regime_roles.short_sleeve: Short the lowest final path-adaptive relative ranks; positive short-bear attribution is mandatory.
expected_regime_roles.stress: Broad balanced sleeves, 0.50 gross, and 0.03 caps limit concentration; positive stress is desirable but all public tail and solvency gates remain mandatory.

falsifier: Stop PARD before every later family observation, including every neighbor, ablation, and risk-control arm, unless the exact no-control reference has trades and a nonempty A5 score row at every manifest-scheduled timestamp after warmup; is complete and solvent; has annualized return strictly above 0.00, net Sharpe at least 0.75, Calmar at least 0.40, maximum drawdown at most 0.30, doubled-cost Sharpe at least 0.35, at least four of six profitable folds, positive-quarter fraction at least 0.55, and trial-adjusted positive probability at least 0.90; has bull, bear, and chop returns each strictly above zero, at least three strictly positive Sharpe values across bull, bear, chop, and stress, worst-regime Sharpe at least -0.25, and long-bull, short-bear, and combined-chop returns each strictly above zero; has for each sleeve exposure at least 0.01, active-bar fraction at least 0.10, mean exposure at least 0.01, and executed notional at least 1000 USDT; has maximum positive-PnL concentration at most 0.40; and has pooled 48-hour score IC strictly above zero, at least four of six fold score ICs strictly above zero, at least 240 pairs and ten scheduled decisions per fold, at least 1440 aggregate pairs, complete causal score evidence, and independent semantic-coupling approval. Unavailable evidence is failure. Controls cannot rescue a failed core. Only after every core and A5 pre-neighbor gate passes may the frozen nine-cell neighborhood be observed; at least seven of nine cells, and therefore at least 0.70, must be profitable and neighborhood median Sharpe must be at least 0.50.
mechanism: Every 48 hours, normalize actual completed organizer close timestamps to UTC and require a contiguous causal 70-close suffix. Standardize an established 21-day return, its final seven-day confirmation, and an independent two-day displacement by established volatility. Average-rank the three values cross-sectionally. Measure the sign agreement of seven nonoverlapping three-day established-path blocks. A fixed blend gives coherent paths more continuation weight and incoherent paths more displacement-reversal weight, then average-ranks the final raw value. Pass that dictionary through the A5 identity hook before selection. Long the top quarter and short the bottom quarter with at least six names per side, 0.25 per side, 0.03 cap, and 0.50 maximum gross.
risk_policy_plan: Begin and stop-test with the exact disabled no-control PARD reference. No risk control, ablation, or neighbor is observable unless the core first passes every numeric aggregate, cost, quarter, fold, multiplicity, regime, role, sleeve-activity, concentration, score-IC, schedule-coverage, and independent A5 review gate declared in the falsifier. Controls cannot repair the stopped UTC or BER mechanisms and cannot create PARD eligibility.
selection_metric: Noncircular staging is mandatory: first observe only the exact no-control center and require every declared core and A5 gate; only then observe the frozen center-plus-eight neighborhood and require at least seven of nine profitable cells (fraction at least 0.70) and median Sharpe at least 0.50; only then may the preregistered risk factorial be observed. Among eligible candidates maximize positive quarters, positive folds, worst-regime Sharpe, worst-fold return, doubled-cost Sharpe, median-fold Sharpe, aggregate Sharpe, and Calmar; then minimize drawdown, positive-PnL concentration, and turnover, with bytewise candidate_id last.
